extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS)/Current Procedural Terminology

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: (CPT©) modifiers are two-digit codes added to procedure codes to enhance the clarity and

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: specificity of medical billing by providing additional details about the services or procedures

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: performed. Modifiers adjust reimbursement rates, specify whether only certain components

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: of a procedure were billed, and report multiple or special circumstances. The purpose of this

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: policy is to establish clear guidelines on the application of common modifiers, including when

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: and how to use them when submitting claims.

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: This policy applies to all Devoted Health plans.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Devoted requires the correct use of CPT© and HCPCS modifiers in accordance with CMS

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: guidelines. When a claim includes a modifier, it will be reviewed to ensure the combination of

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: the procedure code and modifier is accurate and that the modifier is necessary. Incorrect use

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: of modifiers or claims that require modifiers are submitted without such will result in claim

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Below is a table of common modifiers, along with a brief description of how they are typically

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: applied for reimbursement and reporting. These guidelines are intended to address common

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: claim situations but may not apply in all cases, as modifier use can vary. For more detailed

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: information, refer to the CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual Chapter 43 and Chapter 234,

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: or the National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) guidelines.4
